name: Tamtron Group Oyj
summary: Established in 1972 and based in Tampere, Finland, Tamtron Group Oyj specializes in delivering sophisticated weighing technologies. The company's product portfolio encompasses a wide array of scales for various applications, including those for vehicles (on-board and truck), railway systems, and cranes (both fixed and on-board), complemented by load cells and OPU overload protection units. Beyond hardware, Tamtron offers a comprehensive suite of services such as cloud-based solutions, expert consulting, installation, ongoing repair and maintenance, spare parts, and verification. Their advanced systems serve diverse sectors, including earth moving, forestry, logistics, ports, industrial processing and manufacturing, recycling, and energy, with tailored solutions available. Tamtron extends its global footprint, exporting its products to approximately 50 countries via an extensive network of partners.
